msgs.l: google_news: launches new credit card India
msgs.what: One query per weekly sweep (Monday 08:00 IST), India and English. Results older than 30 days are dropped.
msgs.code: engine=google_news  q="launches new credit card India when:30d"  gl=in  hl=en

msgs.what: Only after the guard, cache and budget checks (step 6).
Title, source, date and link for each story. The search_id is kept with every lead as provenance.
Rules remove non-card stories (loans, offers, results) and fuzzy-merge the same launch reported twice.

msgs.l: name the card in each headline
msgs.what: Haiku names the card and issuer for headlines the rules kept; if it fails, the rules' answer stands.
